intro: Verna's Westfall Stew Recipe travels to Salma Saldean as the Furlbrows prepare to leave their farm. Her handwritten formula carries a familiar comfort for those who remain.

p: Verna and Farmer Furlbrow have homesteaded in Westfall for years, but the Defias Brotherhood and rogue harvest golems now run rampant across the countryside. They wait for their wagon to be repaired so they can escape toward Stormwind. While they wait, Verna writes down her beloved formula for Westfall Stew. She entrusts the recipe to travelers bound for her neighboring friend, Salma Saldean, so the familiar comfort of the stew can endure for those left behind.
